description: Source file implementing media::PictureBuffer and media::Picture classes, including constructors, destructors, and methods related to video picture buffers and shared images.

classes.name: PictureBuffer
classes.description: Represents a buffer for video picture data, including various constructors for different configurations and a method to get texture size.

classes.name: Picture
classes.description: Represents a video picture with associated buffer, rect, color space, and overlay properties.

classes.name: ScopedSharedImage
classes.description: Manages a shared image with a mailbox, texture target, and destruction callback.

methods.name: texture_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the specified texture plane.

methods.name: Picture
methods.description: Constructor initializing a Picture object with buffer id, bitstream id, rect, color space, and overlay permission.

methods.name: ScopedSharedImage
methods.description: Constructor for managing a shared image with mailbox, texture target, and destruction closure.
